name: Gakuen Monogatari
source:
Not to be confused with [url=/v8693]Gakuen Monogatari ~Ikenai Houkago~[/url] by Peach Soft.

Hero enters a well-known private high school and falls in love with his English class school teacher Norico at the first sight. One day a Noriko-sensei is suddenly expelled, apparently on the reason that she is intimidated by someone. The hero launches investigation to get to the source of it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
请勿将本作与Peach Soft制作的[url=/v8693]《学园物语～禁忌的放学后～》[/url]混淆。

主人公考入一所知名私立高中，对英语老师纪子一见钟情。一天，纪子老师突然遭到解雇，显然是因为有人对她加以威胁。主人公于是展开调查，试图揪出幕后之人。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
